# Italian Language and Culture Minor
Source: https://academiccatalog.umd.edu/undergraduate/colleges-schools/arts-humanities/languages-literatures-cultures/italian-studies/italian-language-culture-minor/
Source: https://sllc.umd.edu/italian
Source: https://arhu.umd.edu/academics/undergraduate-studies/minors
Fetched: 2026-09-28

## Catalog requirements

15 credits are required for this minor
Prerequisite: Successful completion of ITAL203 Intensive Intermediate Italian
Course | Title | Credits
ITAL204 | Advanced Intermediate Italian | 3
ITAL207 | Speaking and Writing in Italian | 3
ITAL301 | Italian Composition | 3
ITAL311 | Advanced Oral Expression: Current Events | 3
Select one additional course taught in Italian at the 3xx or 4xx level | 3
Total Credits | 15
All courses must be taught in Italian
A maximum of six (6) credits can be applied to the minor from courses taken at other institutions, with the exception of the Study Abroad Program in Italy, which allows the transfer of nine (9) credits.
All courses presented for the minor must be passed with a grade of "C-" or better.
An overall GPA of 2.0 in the minor is required for graduation.
Students who begin their study as native/fluent speakers should seek the advice of the Italian advisor before choosing the courses they will use to replace the core minor courses.

More Opportunities
More Opportunities
The Italian program offers many possibilities to study the Italian language and culture in and outside the classroom. Book an appointment with an advisor to learn more about our events throughout the academic year, the Language Partner Program, the Language House, Study Abroad, the Italian club, experiential learning, internships, scholarship opportunities, and much more.
Il Cinema Ritrovato on Tour
Il Cinema Ritrovato on Tour
Il Cinema Ritrovato on Tour at UMD is organized by the Italian Program in collaboration with the Program in Cinema and Media Studies. It is a festival of restored films provided by the Cineteca di Bologna, Italy and their partners around the world.

About the Italian Program
The Italian program offers a B.A. and a minor for undergraduates. We are committed to the promotion of Italian language and culture in Maryland, the United States, and the world. In our academic programs, we strive to provide outstanding and innovative instruction in Italian studies to prepare students to communicate effectively in spoken and written Italian, to gain and transmit knowledge of the cultural perspectives and artistic products of Italy, and to be culturally sensitive members of today’s diverse society.

Academics
Undergraduate Studies
Minors are an excellent way for students to gain expertise in an area beyond the major. We encourage students to work with their advisors early to incorporate the minor into their Academic Plans.
Applications for all minors remain open until the minor is filled. Students will be taken on a first-come, first-served basis. When you click on the “contact form” below and select the appropriate option on the form, your request will be marked with the date and time. Please keep in mind that any pre-requisites must be completed by the time of application. (Students applying to the Music Performance minor must successfully pass an audition and should contact the advisor through the form below as soon as possible.)
When a minor is listed as CLOSED, it is closed until October 1 in the fall semester or March 1 in the spring semester. You may check this site again at these times. When a minor is listed as WAITLIST, it is closed, but you may put yourself on a waitlist by clicking on "contact form" below and selecting the appropriate option.
